title: 12 Best Medellín's Craft Beer Scene
description: Discover the 12 best craft beer spots in Medellín for 2026. From pioneering breweries like 3 Cordilleras to cozy local pubs, find your perfect pint in El Poblado, Laureles, and beyond.

places.name: 3 Cordilleras Cervecería
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample the 'Mestiza' (amber ale) and 'Negra' (porter). Don't miss their tasting flights.

places.name: Cervecería Maoli
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'IPA Maoli' for a hoppy kick and pair it with one of their specialty burgers.

places.name: Cervecería Libre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask about their seasonal specials; they often have unique fruit-infused or experimental beers.

places.name: El Hops Cervecería Artesanal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Pale Ale' is consistently excellent. Pair it with their loaded fries for a true comfort food experience.

places.name: Cervecería Premium Medellín (CPM)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Rubia' (blonde ale) is a refreshing choice, or their 'Roja' (red ale) for something with more character.

places.name: The Beer Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for recommendations from their extensive bottle list or try one of their rotating taps featuring imported brews.

places.name: Vaggon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Vaggon Pilsner' is a solid choice. Pair it with their loaded hot dogs or artisanal burgers.

places.name: Brew House Pub
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their rotating tap list; they often feature interesting local collaborations or seasonal brews.

places.name: La Caverna del Dragón
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire about their current craft beer offerings, as they rotate. Their 'Dragon's Blood' cocktail is also popular for non-beer drinkers.

places.name: Patio Bonito Craft Beer Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the knowledgeable staff for a flight recommendation to explore different local styles.

places.name: Cervecería Artesanal El Pueblo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Pilsen' is surprisingly crisp and refreshing, a great value option.

places.name: Medellín Beer Factory (MBF)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Amber Ale' and one of their hearty burgers or their 'picada' (mixed grill) to share.
